lore: A shoe of copper for a hoof that has seen many roads.
use: Smith the Horseshoe Upgrade with a copper ingot. Tier 1, worth 1 point, durability 120. Four go into the hoof slots of a horse, donkey, mule or undead horse.
secret: Two shoes of one tier score the same as four of the tier below. Each loses one point of durability per 40 blocks ridden on the ground.

lore: A shoe of iron for a hoof that has seen many roads.
use: Smith the Horseshoe Upgrade with an iron ingot. Tier 2, worth 2 points, durability 180. Four go into the hoof slots of a horse, donkey, mule or undead horse.
secret: Two shoes of one tier score the same as four of the tier below. Each loses one point of durability per 40 blocks ridden on the ground.

lore: A shoe of diamond for a hoof that has seen many roads.

lore: A shoe of Netherite that does not mind a lava shore.
use: Smith the Horseshoe Upgrade with a Diamond Horseshoe and a netherite ingot. Tier 5, durability 500, fire resistant. A full set gives 86% of the bonus.
secret: Enchantments and wear carry over from the diamond shoe. Four shoes also add 5% speed and jump strength and make long falls hurt 10% more.

lore: The last shoe of the line: it walks the soul sand as if it were a road.
use: Smith the Horseshoe Upgrade with a Netherite Horseshoe and an Enderite Ingot (needs SimpleBuilding). Tier 6, durability 620, fire resistant. A full set gives 100% of the bonus.
secret: Soul sand and honey slow the horse far less, and it steers sideways much better. Enchantments and wear carry over from the Netherite shoe.

lore: A template shaped like a horseshoe, cold to the touch like a stable at dawn.
use: Used up in the smithing table to make a horseshoe. Found in village weaponsmith and tannery chests and by brushing trail ruins. Copy it with an iron ingot and seven copper ingots for two.
secret: Brushing trail-ruin blocks also gives a worn Copper or Iron Horseshoe. The template itself is used up like any Vanilla template.

lore: A book of saddles, harnesses and quiet roads.
use: The Simple Riding Guide covers Tailwind, Leaping, mount armor and the horseshoes. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.
